scenario: AITA for telling my mom not to touch my things? | Not sure how to start this off. My mom and I dont have a good relationship at all, ever since I've moved in with my boyfriend it's gotten better. But not really. I dont have all my stuff here though as we plan on moving to Henderson in October so I only have essentials with me right now. Today, I am going to my school to get pictures for the virtual graduation next month, and I want my flute with me. My flute is my everything. AITA?
